objective: mean |log10(predicted_ppb / measured_ppb)| over the matched rows of the two literature xylose HVP benchmarks, per compound
constraint: base_factor is a surviving fraction and lives in [0.0001, 1.0] — the same clamp `_resolve_upstream_observability_factor` applies at runtime

decision_rules.conservative_edge: among admissible values within indifference_dex of the profile minimum, adopt the SMALLEST factor
decision_rules.admissibility: an unconstrained optimum outside (0, 1] is reported SATURATED and the incumbent is kept — a boundary value is not a fit

applied_history.basis: conservative edge of the 0.05623-0.07356 indifference band; interior and identified, unlike the two thiols whose optima sit above the physical maximum of 1.0
